newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bank Leu maintains buy on Kuoni shares.
newsitem.headline: Bank Leu maintains buy on Kuoni shares.

text.p: Bank Leu equity analysts said the outlook for Swiss-based travel and tour group Kuoni still appears positive.
"We therefore maintain our rating as a buy," Bank Leu analysts Barbara Hauser and Christoph Streit said in a study published Friday.
"The outlook for Kuoni is still very positive. With a price/earnings ratio estimated in 1997 at 15 times, Kuoni registered shares do not seem too highly valued," they said.
In addition, they said additional chances for growth, which would likely lead to the earnings estimate being revised up, were not yet reflected in the share price.
Kuoni registered shares were quoted on Friday up 190 Swiss francs at 4,430.
